Inspect the Deployment's .status.conditions for Progressing=False with reason ProgressDeadlineExceeded or ReplicaFailure. Check for quota errors, readiness probe failures, or image pull errors in the events. If a failure is confirmed, consider rolling back to the previous version (`kubectl rollout undo deployment/<name>`) or fixing the underlying issue (e.g., increase quota, correct probes) and redeploy."}
